title: Prime Minister congratulates Kiran Pahal, Poovamma MR, Prachi and Vithya Ramraj on winning Gold in Women’s 4×400m Relay at Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has congratulated Kiran Pahal, Poovamma MR, Prachi and Vithya Ramraj on their magnificent performance in the Women’s 4×400m Relay at the Asian Games. The Prime Minister said that their speed and determination powered India to the top of the podium and described the achievement as a proud moment for Indian athletics. Shri Modi said that the performance was a wonderful example of what teamwork can achieve and extended his best wishes to the athletes for their future endeavours. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X; “Congratulations to Kiran Pahal, Poovamma MR, Prachi and Vithya Ramraj on a magnificent performance in the Women’s 4×400m Relay at the Asian Games. Their speed and determination powered India to the top of the podium. This is a proud moment for Indian athletics and a wonderful example of what teamwork can achieve! Best wishes to the athletes for the endeavours ahead: PM @narendramodi”
